title: Infer a Theory: from observations to effective actions and renormalisation
summary: Describe a fluctuating quantity in plain English, one observation per card with its scale and an estimative-probability phrase (Sherman Kent's CIA reference, a survey calibration and your working probability shown apart), and see the claims become a maximum-entropy effective action with a posterior over coupling constants, identifiability, conflicts and model inadequacy. Wilsonian coarse-graining (block averages, or literal decimation for a binary field) runs the theory toward large scales with exact coarse observables, projected couplings, projection diagnostics, numerical beta estimates and relevant or irrelevant directions; inverse RG gives widening ensembles of compatible finer-scale theories; and expected information gain ranks the next measurement in plain English. Opens on a live-football bandwidth example. Deterministic, offline, from file:// and in an iframe, with a narrated beamdswitch deck.
